temporary_windows_drive_mapping.reason: Initial checkout hit Windows MAX_PATH on long generated paths. No temporary drive mapping was required; the worktree was recovered by enabling local git core.longpaths=true and restoring the affected checkout paths.

telegram_connection_behavior_summary: The Telegram Connection screen now renders the runtime credential visibility status for required Polymarket and Telegram environment variables.
The screen shows only connected/not connected status, optional length, and safe fingerprints already produced by the runtime diagnostic; raw secret values are not rendered.

The missing funder address case is called out with product copy explaining that some Polymarket checks may require a funder/proxy wallet address and that the operator may temporarily use the wallet address if they know both are the same.
The refresh button is registered as a same-message navigation action and refreshes the local dry-run runtime visibility diagnostic only when runtime refresh is enabled.
The instruction screen lists required environment variable names, the dry-run PowerShell check command, and a warning never to send private key/API secret/passphrase values in Telegram chat.
The Balance screen routes to Connection when required credentials are incomplete, and Launch blocks with product copy when the credential/signer evidence chain is incomplete.
The primary Telegram menu remains product-facing and unchanged.
credential_visibility_behavior_summary: Runtime context loading now includes the latest runtime credential visibility artifacts and signer diagnostic evidence artifacts through the Telegram status registry.
Telegram summarizes credential visibility using safe normalized status keys instead of raw environment values.
Refresh uses run_runtime_credential_visibility_diagnostic in dry-run mode with no signer instantiation, no order submission, no cancellation, and no live enablement.
Funder address remains operator-provided; the bot does not infer, auto-set, or silently guess it.

runtime_credential_visibility_diagnostic.note: This Codex process exposed PMBOT Telegram aliases but not Polymarket credentials. The runner printed presence, length, and safe fingerprints only.

notes: Added runtime code calls only the existing local dry-run credential visibility diagnostic.
Expected text matches are limited to environment variable names, no-secret warnings, false safety flags, and test assertions that forbidden controls are absent.

safety_statement: PMBOT remains not live and not autonomous. This change adds Telegram visibility for redacted runtime credential diagnostics only. It does not add live trading, order submission, order cancellation, signing by default, signer instantiation by default, wallet connection UI, raw secret output, full signed payload output, in-chat secret collection, schedulers, daemons, background workers, autonomous loops, true live-allowance flags, or true trading-request flags.
remaining_risks: The validation shell did not expose Polymarket credentials, so the runtime credential visibility smoke correctly remained blocked_missing_private_key.
The validation shell did expose PMBOT Telegram aliases; only redacted status and safe diagnostics were reported.
Operator-specific runtime visibility depends on the environment seen by the actual Telegram process.
